content: We have two subnetworks: subnet1 (A to X1 via N1,N2) with resistors R1,R2,R3 values given. Subnet2 (B to X1 via N_b1 etc) with resistors R1..R4 (but note naming conflict). The combined network should have total 7 resistors as notes. Already combined as R1,R2,R3 from subnet1 and R4,R5,R6,R7 from subnet2 (renamed). Simulated resistances match measurements: A-B 66.363 approx matches 66.364 measurement. A-N_b1 21.363 matches 21.364.
